$comment: Seed reference data for the Livestock Trade Management platform. Values extracted from 'Active Purchase Orders 07-08-2026 (WORKING).xlsx' and 'Active Purchase Orders 12-08-2026.xlsx'. CRITICAL: the two blocks below are governed differently. 'everhealth' is owned, editable and money-moving. 'abattoir' is received data, ingested from each submission, used ONLY for the cross-check in PRD 5.2, and must never be editable in this system.

everhealth.$comment: OWNED BY EVERHEALTH. Admin-editable, versioned, effective-dated. Changes to dnbp_factor_by_species or cif_buffer_per_kg change what the buyer may pay — they require an impact preview, a second confirmation, and an audit entry.

cif_buffer_per_kg.note: Deducted in column X for EVERY line, CIF and FAS alike. This is deliberate and confirmed by the business — do not restrict it to CIF. Column K (abattoir-owned) applies it to CIF only, which is why K and X diverge on FAS lines.

dnbp_factor_by_species.$comment: ★★ SOURCE-OF-TRUTH INPUT ★★ bing_dnbp = (avg_price_aud - cif_buffer) * factor[species]. Half of the critical path of the business. ADMIN-only, impact-previewed, audited.

missing.MUTTON: ABSENT in the source workbook while MUTTON orders exist in real data (e.g. CED18656). Blocks publication with NO_DNBP_FACTOR. Do not guess. See PRD open decision D1.

notes.VEAL: 0.50 diverges sharply from the financier's implied 0.7143 (1/1.40), while SHEEP, LAMB and GOAT agree within 0.5%. Material and unresolved — see PRD open decision D4.

standard_weight_by_species.$comment: Basis for the per-kg conversions Y, Z and AA. Does NOT affect bing_dnbp. A missing entry degrades the supporting analysis only and must not block a publication.

missing.MUTTON: ABSENT. Raises NO_STANDARD_WEIGHT (WARN). Sheet1!O:P suggests 24, but that table is not referenced by any formula. See PRD open decision D1.

conflicts.LAMB: The engine table (X1:Y4) says 18; the unused reference table (Sheet1!O:P) says 19. Seed 18 — it is the table the formulas actually read. See PRD open decision D2.

saleyard_calendar.$comment: Drives the Buy Instruction prepayment block and the buyer PWA's default saleyard.

values.note: Requires $40k to Southern Central to open the Ballarat market
Requires $147k to Southern Central to open the Northern Markets (Wagga and Yass)
Part of the Northern Markets arrangement above

dnbp_display_rounding.note: Always round DOWN. Rounding a ceiling price up would authorise an overpay.

abattoir.$comment: OWNED BY THE ABATTOIR. Received inside each submission's lookup sheet ('Sheet1' in the 07-08 file, 'Inputs' in the 12-08 file). READ-ONLY in this system. Used ONLY to cross-check the received values in columns K, M, N, O, Q, T, U and V (PRD 5.2). NEVER used to compute anything, and never to compute bing_dnbp. POST /reference-data/versions must reject writes to any table in this block with 403 ABATTOIR_OWNED_TABLE.

notes.GOAT: The table says 0, but every active GOAT line arrives with a hand-set 0.5. Receive and use 0.5 as submitted, mark it HAND_SET, and report the divergence. It is the abattoir's number to set — do not correct it. See PRD open decision D3.

reference_weight_by_species.note: Present in the abattoir's lookup sheet but referenced by no formula. Retained only to explain the LAMB 18-vs-19 conflict (PRD D2). Do not use it for anything.

required_margin_by_species.note: Explains the abattoir's newer benchmark: dnbp_benchmark = K / (1 + margin). Reference only — never an Everhealth engine.

benchmark_fixed_cost_per_head.note: Used inside the abattoir's own 'Gayan' DNBP formula in column T: K - ((fixed_cost + M - O - N) / P). Stored only so the PRD 5.2 cross-check can reproduce T. Cannot affect bing_dnbp. Purpose of the 40/34 split is unexplained — see PRD open decision D7.

open_registries.$comment: OPEN REGISTRIES - rows in a table, admin-managed at runtime. These are a STARTING SET, NOT A LIMIT. Do NOT implement as a Postgres ENUM, Python Enum, or TS string-literal union: adding a species must be an admin form action, not a migration and deploy. The system holds no rule about which livestock the business may trade; it only refuses to invent a DNBP for a species with no configured factor. See PRD 6.9.

species.pricing_prerequisite: dnbp_factor (PRD 6.5) is REQUIRED before a species can be priced; standard_weight (PRD 6.4) is optional and affects Y/Z/AA only
species.unknown_value_handling: store verbatim, flag it, never reject the row or the file

product_type.note: Abattoir cut specs grow over time. Cannot block DNBP - AC does not depend on M.

closed_enums.$comment: Genuinely closed. Safe to implement as real enums.
